# Gregale

> Gregale is a serverless platform (FaaS) that runs functions in Firecracker microVMs on bare metal in the EU. Apps scale to zero when idle — holding no memory at all — and wake from a VM snapshot in under 350 ms when a request arrives. Deploy with one CLI command from source or any OCI image.

Gregale is CLI-first (`gregale deploy`), with a full web console for
everything the API can do.

Key facts:

- Isolation: every instance is a Firecracker microVM, not a container in a
  shared kernel. Cold starts are snapshot restores, p95 under 350 ms.
- Scale to zero: idle apps are parked and hold zero RAM; you pay only for
  GB-hours actually resident. Billing is metered per app.
- Runtimes: Node 24, Python 3.13, Go 1.24 — or bring any OCI image.
- Build from source: push a repo or tarball; buildpacks (Railpack) or your
  Dockerfile, with SBOM, build provenance, and optional signed-deploy
  enforcement with trusted publisher keys.
- Batteries included: cron jobs, queues, delayed tasks, edge rules, custom
  domains, per-PR preview environments, sealed secrets, egress lockdown
  (deny-by-default outbound), request tracing, structured logs.
- Kubernetes migration: upload a repo with k8s manifests or a Compose file
  and the importer maps workloads, managed services, and crons onto Gregale.
- Hosting: own bare metal (Hetzner, Frankfurt). EU data residency, GDPR
  export and deletion built into the product.
- Pricing: metered GB-hours with a plan allowance; spend caps and egress
  budgets are user-configurable in the console.

## Docs

- [Documentation index](https://gregale.dev/docs): all guides and reference.
- [How scaling to zero works](https://gregale.dev/docs/scale-to-zero): the
  park/wake lifecycle, snapshots, and what the sub-350 ms wake means.
- [Deploying from source](https://gregale.dev/docs/deploy-from-source):
  repo or tarball to running app, buildpacks and Dockerfiles.
- [CLI setup](https://gregale.dev/docs/cli): install and authenticate the
  `gregale` command-line tool.
- [Node runtime](https://gregale.dev/docs/runtime-node): Node 24 specifics.
- [Python runtime](https://gregale.dev/docs/runtime-python): Python 3.13 specifics.
- [Go runtime](https://gregale.dev/docs/runtime-go): Go 1.24 specifics.
- [Preview environments](https://gregale.dev/docs/preview-environments):
  per-pull-request deployments.
- [Storage](https://gregale.dev/docs/storage): persistent volumes and object
  storage attached to apps.
- [Trace propagation](https://gregale.dev/docs/tracing): W3C trace context
  through the platform.
- [Egress denylist](https://gregale.dev/docs/egress-denylist): outbound
  network lockdown reference.
